title: Cron jobs over FTP: auditing a server you just inherited
lede: A site lands in your lap with an FTP credential and a database dump. Somewhere in there, jobs are firing on a schedule. You need to know which ones, before one breaks at 03:00 on Sunday.
hero_alt: Brass ship's bell on dark oak bracket against bone plaster wall, hemp lanyard with clay-red wax-sealed paper tag.
